title: ci(release): sign version commits through the github api

files.patch:
@@ -43,6 +43,8 @@ jobs:
           title: "chore(repo): version packages"
           version: pnpm run version
           publish: pnpm run release
+          # main requires signed commits. Through the API, GitHub signs the version commit it creates.
+          commitMode: github-api
           # Releases are created here, then their bodies are rewritten below.
           createGithubReleases: true
         env:
@@ -51,9 +53,14 @@ jobs:
 
       # changesets sets `published` before it exits on a failed package, so these steps still
       # run for the packages that did reach npm. The job stays failed either way.
+      # The action creates each released tag through the API as a lightweight ref, while changeset
+      # publish made an annotated one under the same name; pushing that again is refused.
       - name: Push tags
         if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.changesets.outputs.published == 'true' }}
-        run: git push --tags
+        run: |
+          for tag in $(git tag --points-at HEAD); do
+            git ls-remote --exit-code --tags origin "refs/tags/$tag" > /dev/null || git push origin "refs/tags/$tag"
+          done
 
       # Rebuilds each release body from that package's PRs and changesets, then moves Latest
       # back to evlog. The header of scripts/release-notes/index.mjs says why.
